components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button for product flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #eb477e; color: #ffffff; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; padding: 12px 20px; font: 800 14px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms ease-out, background 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -8px rgba(235, 71, 126, 0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #db2777; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(244, 114, 182, 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Hi uses a product-first visual system: familiar controls, soft surfaces, and careful hierarchy. The interface should feel like a trusted care companion in Vietnamese, not a decorative wellness poster.
keyCharacteristics: Warm product UI with pink as an action and selection accent.
Familiar app patterns for dashboards, settings, calendars, forms, and admin panels.
White or lightly tinted surfaces with clear borders and restrained shadows.
Strong labels and readable body copy for private health contexts.

rules.name: The Pink Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Pink marks action, selection, or meaningful relationship/health state. It is not filler decoration.

rules.name: The No Gray On Tint Rule
rules.body: Gray text on pink, rose, violet, sky, emerald, or red tints is prohibited unless contrast is verified.

rules.name: The Solid Text Rule
rules.body: Gradient text is prohibited for product headings, metrics, prices, and labels.

dos: Do use Care Pink for primary actions, selected states, and meaningful health/relationship markers.
Do keep product UI familiar and stable across dashboards, forms, modals, calendars, and admin pages.
Do verify WCAG AA contrast for labels, metadata, placeholders, and tinted panels.
donts: Don't use generic AI SaaS dashboards, neon purple/cyan gradients as a default identity, excessive glassmorphism, decorative gradient text, washed-out gray text on tinted backgrounds, over-rounded nested cards, bouncy motion, or greeting-card UI for serious health tasks.
Don't use gray text on colored backgrounds without checking contrast.
Don't use gradient text for headings, prices, metrics, or labels.
